{{Quote|I said no!"<br />"Your mouth says no, but your body wants the festival gift I have for you...|Pamr and Ilir Post|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25" />}}
'''Pamr''' was a young [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] that was being harassed by [[Ilir Post]] and two of his friends, in the aftermath of a [[Harvest Festival]]. She was rescued by [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], who not only thrashed all three young men, but reported their crime to [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]].

Rather than let Ilir be prosecuted, the [[agro-combine]] his father worked for, [[Allied Grain and Roughage]], coerced Fel to accept a place at the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] and miss Ilir's trial.
